headline: The Nursing & Patient Care Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can teach and explain a safe routine in Spanish, handle surprises such as an unlisted allergy or a phone order, give feedback and settle conflict with the right register, talk through an incident, a near miss or an emergency, and write, phone and walk a patient through a clear plan for going home.

lessons.title: Orient a New Graduate Nurse to the Unit Routine
lessons.objective: Walk a new nurse through the order of a shift and explain the reason for each step in Spanish.

words.note: Use el recién graduado for a man.
Short for el reporte de turno; common on the unit.

words.en: First we get the report, then we visit each patient.
words.es: Primero recibimos el reporte, luego visitamos a cada paciente.

words.en: First we see the unstable patients, because they can get worse fast.
words.es: Primero vemos a los pacientes inestables, porque pueden empeorar rápido.

words.en: Then we chart everything, because what isn't charted wasn't done.
words.es: Luego registramos todo, porque lo que no se anota no se hizo.

words.en: We check supplies early; that's why we never run short.
words.es: Revisamos los suministros temprano; por eso nunca nos falta nada.

words.en: We start with rounds; that's why we know who needs help first.
words.es: Empezamos con las rondas; por eso sabemos quién necesita ayuda primero.

words.en: First wash your hands, then we go into the room.
words.es: Primero lávate las manos, después entramos al cuarto.

words.en: If you have doubts, ask me; it's better to ask than guess.
words.es: Si tienes dudas, pregúntame; es mejor preguntar que adivinar.

words.en: After rounds, we restock the supply cart.
words.es: Después de las rondas, reponemos el carro de suministros.

lessons.speaking: You are the experienced RN, and the AI is a new graduate nurse on her first morning: walk her through the order of the shift and give the reason for each step, using primero, luego, porque and por eso.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero, luego, porque, por eso)

examples.es: Primero tomamos los signos vitales; luego los anotamos.
examples.en: First we take the vital signs; then we chart them.

examples.es: Revisamos el carro temprano porque después no hay tiempo.
examples.en: We check the cart early because later there is no time.

lessons.title: Why We Round Every Hour: Teaching a Nursing Student
lessons.objective: Explain to a nursing student what hourly rounding covers and why it prevents problems.

words.en: We check pain, position, the bathroom and the call light.
words.es: Se revisan el dolor, la posición, el baño y el timbre.

words.en: If the patient has pain, the charge nurse is notified.
words.es: Si el paciente tiene dolor, se avisa a la enfermera encargada.

words.en: If the patient isn't repositioned, the skin can get damaged.
words.es: Si no se cambia de posición, se puede dañar la piel.

words.en: According to unit policy, rounds are done every hour.
words.es: Según la política de la unidad, se hace la ronda cada hora.

words.en: If the patient can't get to the bathroom, we help them.
words.es: Si el paciente no puede llegar al baño, se le ayuda.

words.en: The call light is left within the patient's reach.
words.es: Se deja el timbre al alcance del paciente.

words.en: The time of each round is written on the log.
words.es: Se anota la hora de cada ronda en la hoja.

words.en: What do you think happens if a patient isn't checked?
words.es: ¿Qué crees que pasa si no se revisa a un paciente?

lessons.speaking: You are the RN at the nurses' station, and the AI is a nursing student: explain what hourly rounding covers and why it prevents problems, using impersonal se and si + present (se revisa, si hay dolor, se avisa).

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (se revisa, si el paciente tiene dolor, se avisa)

examples.es: Se revisa el timbre en cada ronda.
examples.en: The call light is checked on every round.

examples.es: Si el paciente tiene dolor, se avisa al médico.
examples.en: If the patient has pain, the doctor is notified.

lessons.title: Teach a Teenager to Check Blood Sugar at Home
lessons.objective: Coach a teenage patient through using a glucose meter with short, clear commands and a teach-back.

words.en: Wash them with soap and water, and dry them well.
words.es: Lávatelas con agua y jabón, y sécatelas bien.

words.en: Take out the strip and put it in the meter.
words.es: Saca la tira y métela en el glucómetro.

words.en: Prick the side of your finger and don't squeeze it hard.
words.es: Pínchate el lado del dedo y no lo aprietes fuerte.

words.en: Don't touch it with wet fingers.
words.es: No la toques con los dedos mojados.
words.note: The pronoun la refers to the test strip.

words.en: Check it on the screen and write it in your log.
words.es: Revísalo en la pantalla y anótalo en tu diario.

words.en: Your target range is in the plan your doctor wrote.
words.es: Tu rango meta está en el plan que escribió tu médico.

words.en: Throw it in the container; don't leave it loose.
words.es: Tírala en el contenedor; no la dejes suelta.
words.note: The pronoun la refers to the lancet.

words.en: Now say it back to me, step by step.
words.es: Ahora repítemelo tú, paso por paso.

lessons.speaking: You are the nurse, and the AI is a 16-year-old newly diagnosed with diabetes: teach the meter step by step with informal tú commands and pronouns (lávatelas, revísalo, no lo toques) and have the teen repeat each step back.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (revísalo, no lo toques, lávatelas)

examples.es: Revísalo en la pantalla y no lo toques.
examples.en: Check it on the screen and don't touch it.

examples.es: Lávatelas bien antes de pincharte.
examples.en: Wash them well before pricking yourself.

lessons.title: Read the Medication Label and Pharmacy Insert Together
lessons.objective: Read a medication label and the hospital policy aloud with a new nurse and explain what to check before and after giving it.

words.note: Also called la hoja informativa de la farmacia.

words.en: Before giving the medication, you have to read the whole label.
words.es: Antes de dar el medicamento, hay que leer la etiqueta completa.

words.en: You have to verify the patient's name with the wristband.
words.es: Hay que verificar el nombre del paciente con la pulsera.

words.en: The label says it is stored in the refrigerator.
words.es: La etiqueta dice que se guarda en el refrigerador.

words.en: According to hospital policy, a double check is required.
words.es: Según la política del hospital, hay que hacer doble verificación.

words.en: After giving the medication, you have to chart it right away.
words.es: Después de dar el medicamento, hay que anotarlo enseguida.

words.en: The insert lists possible side effects; you have to monitor the patient.
words.es: El prospecto menciona posibles efectos secundarios; hay que vigilar al paciente.

words.en: Before opening it, check the lot number and expiration date.
words.es: Antes de abrirlo, revisa el lote y la fecha de vencimiento.

words.en: If the label isn't clear, you have to ask the pharmacy.
words.es: Si la etiqueta no es clara, hay que preguntarle a la farmacia.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN in the medication room, and the AI is a new colleague: read the label and hospital policy aloud together and explain what to check, using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que, quoting what the label says.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de dar el medicamento, hay que leer la etiqueta)

examples.es: Antes de dar el medicamento, hay que leer la etiqueta.
examples.en: Before giving the medication, you have to read the label.

examples.es: Después de darlo, hay que anotar la hora.
examples.en: After giving it, you have to chart the time.

lessons.title: The Allergy the Chart Never Mentioned
lessons.objective: Tell the physician what a patient just revealed about an allergy and propose a safe next step.

words.note: Common Mexican word; 'picazón' is also heard.

words.en: The patient told me he had a reaction years ago.
words.es: El paciente me dijo que tuvo una reacción hace años.
words.note: Preterite (tuvo) for the event; use with the physician.

words.en: Doctor, the chart said nothing about that reaction.
words.es: Doctor, el expediente no decía nada de esa reacción.
words.note: Imperfect (decía) for the background state. Formal.

words.en: I decided not to give the dose until I spoke with you.
words.es: Decidí no dar la dosis hasta hablar con usted.

words.en: It would be better to call pharmacy to confirm the allergy.
words.es: Sería mejor llamar a farmacia para confirmar la alergia.

words.en: Could you order another antibiotic while we confirm, doctor?
words.es: ¿Podría indicar otro antibiótico mientras confirmamos, doctor?
words.note: Formal; the RN asks, the physician decides.

words.en: What happened when you took that antibiotic last time?
words.es: ¿Qué pasó cuando tomó ese antibiótico la última vez?

words.en: Did your throat feel tight, or just itching?
words.es: ¿Sentía la garganta cerrada o solo comezón?
words.note: Imperfect for how it felt back then.

words.en: Don't worry, we are going to verify it before giving you anything.
words.es: No se preocupe, vamos a verificarlo antes de darle nada.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN, and the AI is the physician on the phone: report what the patient just told you about a past reaction (me dijo que tenía…, tuvo…), say you are holding the dose, and propose a next step with sería mejor llamar a farmacia.

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (me dijo que..., sería mejor llamar a farmacia)

examples.es: Me dijo que tenía urticaria cuando tomó penicilina.
examples.en: She told me she had hives when she took penicillin.

examples.es: Sería mejor confirmar con farmacia antes de dar la dosis.
examples.en: It would be better to confirm with pharmacy before giving the dose.

lessons.title: Pharmacy Substitution: The Usual Tablet Is Out of Stock
lessons.objective: Explain a pharmacy substitution to a worried patient and confirm it with the prescriber.

words.en: This pill is smaller than the previous one.
words.es: Esta pastilla es más pequeña que la anterior.

words.en: The doctor is going to confirm the change before giving it to you.
words.es: El médico va a confirmar el cambio antes de dársela.

words.en: According to the pharmacy note, it has the same active ingredient.
words.es: Según la nota de la farmacia, tiene el mismo ingrediente activo.
words.note: Attribute the claim to the pharmacy.

words.en: The one before was bigger and a different color.
words.es: La de antes era más grande y de otro color.

words.en: Doctor, pharmacy doesn't have the usual brand; do you approve this substitution?
words.es: Doctor, la farmacia no tiene la marca habitual; ¿aprueba esta sustitución?

words.en: Don't worry, I won't give you anything without the doctor's approval.
words.es: No se preocupe, no le daré nada sin la aprobación del médico.

words.en: According to pharmacy, this tablet works the same as the other one.
words.es: Según la farmacia, esta tableta funciona igual que la otra.

words.en: I am going to let you know when the doctor's answer arrives.
words.es: Le voy a avisar cuando llegue la respuesta del médico.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN, and the AI is a worried patient: explain, using ir a and comparisons (esta pastilla es más pequeña, el médico va a confirmar), why the tablet changed, according to the pharmacy's note, and calm their fears.

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (esta pastilla es más pequeña, el médico va a confirmar)

examples.es: Esta tableta es más pequeña y más redonda.
examples.en: This tablet is smaller and rounder.

examples.es: Voy a llamar al médico para confirmar el cambio.
examples.en: I am going to call the doctor to confirm the change.

lessons.title: Phone Order at the Station: Read Back Every Number
lessons.objective: Take a verbal order by phone, read back each number and unit, and later retell what happened.

words.note: Write the word out; avoid the abbreviation 'U'.

words.en: According to the doctor's order, I repeat: 5 milligrams, every 6 hours.
words.es: Según la orden del médico, repito: 5 miligramos, cada 6 horas.
words.note: Example numbers only; always read back the doctor's own.

words.en: Doctor, there is a lot of noise; can you repeat the number, please?
words.es: Doctor, hay mucho ruido; ¿puede repetir el número, por favor?

words.en: According to your order, I repeat: 0.5 milliliters, not 5; is that correct?
words.es: Según su orden, repito: 0.5 mililitros, no 5; ¿es correcto?
words.note: Say 'cero punto cinco'. Mexico uses the decimal point.

words.en: I wrote down the order and repeated it to the doctor.
words.es: Anoté la orden y se la repetí al doctor.
words.note: Preterite narration, to the charge nurse.

words.en: The doctor called at 2 and gave a verbal order.
words.es: El doctor llamó a las 2 y dio una orden verbal.

words.en: I didn't use abbreviations; I wrote the word "units" in full.
words.es: No usé abreviaturas; escribí la palabra «unidades» completa.

words.en: Can you spell the name of the medication for me, please?
words.es: ¿Me puede deletrear el nombre del medicamento, por favor?

words.en: I need your cosignature on this order, doctor.
words.es: Necesito su contrafirma en esta orden, doctor.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN, and the AI is the physician on the phone, then the charge nurse: take the order and read back each number and unit with repito:, then tell what happened in the preterite (llamó, anoté, repetí).

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (según la orden del médico, repito: ...)

examples.es: El doctor llamó y yo escribí la orden.
examples.en: The doctor called and I wrote the order.

examples.es: Repetí cada número y cada unidad.
examples.en: I repeated each number and each unit.

lessons.title: Saying No to a Visitor Who Wants to Share Home Medicine
lessons.objective: Refuse politely and firmly when a relative wants the patient to take medicine or food from home.

words.en: Please, don't give it to her yet.
words.es: Por favor, no se lo dé todavía.

words.en: I don't recommend that your mother take that.
words.es: No recomiendo que su mamá tome eso.

words.en: I understand your concern; I just want her to be safe.
words.es: Entiendo su preocupación; solo quiero que ella esté segura.

words.en: By hospital policy, we need the doctor's permission first.
words.es: Por política del hospital, necesitamos el permiso del médico primero.

words.en: I'm going to ask the doctor whether it can be used.
words.es: Voy a preguntarle al médico si se puede usar.

words.en: Don't give her tea or home-cooked food for now.
words.es: No le dé té ni comida de casa por ahora.

words.en: Better keep them in your bag while I talk to the doctor.
words.es: Mejor guárdelas en su bolso mientras hablo con el médico.

words.en: I appreciate that you care so much about her.
words.es: Le agradezco que se preocupe tanto por ella.
words.note: Subjunctive after agradecer que; warm, formal.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN, and the AI is a patient's son who wants her to take herbal pills: refuse politely with negative commands (no se lo dé) and no recomiendo que + subjunctive, explain the doctor must approve, and offer to ask.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no se lo dé, no recomiendo que tome eso)

examples.es: No le dé esas pastillas a su mamá.
examples.en: Don't give those pills to your mother.

examples.es: No recomiendo que ella tome ese té.
examples.en: I don't recommend that she drink that tea.

lessons.title: Feedback for a Nursing Assistant Who Skips Hand Hygiene
lessons.objective: Give respectful, specific feedback to a colleague about hand hygiene and agree on what will change.

words.en: I want you to wash your hands between each patient.
words.es: Quiero que te laves las manos entre cada paciente.

words.en: I recommend that you use the gel before going in.
words.es: Te recomiendo que uses el gel antes de entrar.

words.en: I saw that you went from one room to another without washing.
words.es: Vi que pasaste de un cuarto a otro sin lavarte.
words.note: Describe what you saw, don't accuse.

words.en: What do you need so that it's easier to wash your hands?
words.es: ¿Qué necesitas para que sea más fácil lavarte las manos?

words.en: I hope you'll tell me if any sink is out of soap.
words.es: Espero que me digas si falta jabón en algún lavabo.

words.en: I ask that you tell me if dry skin bothers you.
words.es: Te pido que me avises si la piel reseca te molesta.

words.en: I understand there's a rush; still, I want you to do it every time.
words.es: Entiendo que hay prisa; aun así, quiero que lo hagas siempre.

words.en: I'm telling you privately because the policy includes all of us.
words.es: Te lo digo en privado porque la política nos incluye a todos.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN, and the AI is a nursing assistant who skips hand hygiene: in private, describe what you saw, listen to her reasons, and agree on changes using quiero que… and te recomiendo que…

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que se lave, te recomiendo que uses)

examples.es: Quiero que te laves las manos antes de entrar al cuarto.
examples.en: I want you to wash your hands before entering the room.

examples.es: Te recomiendo que uses el dispensador de la pared.
examples.en: I recommend that you use the dispenser on the wall.

lessons.title: Two Nurses, One Break Schedule: Settling the Dispute
lessons.objective: Listen to two colleagues' complaints, report what each said, and help them agree on break coverage.

words.en: Marta said she was covering your patients.
words.es: Marta dijo que estaba cubriendo a tus pacientes.

words.en: Ana was saying there was nobody available to cover her.
words.es: Ana decía que no había nadie disponible para cubrirla.

words.en: Let me repeat what I heard, to see if I understood.
words.es: Déjenme repetir lo que escuché, para ver si entendí bien.

words.en: She said she had told you before leaving.
words.es: Ella dijo que te había avisado antes de salir.

words.en: You told me you were going to cover my patients.
words.es: Tú me dijiste que ibas a cubrir mis pacientes.
words.note: Informal; said by one nurse to the other.

words.en: I propose we alternate who takes the break first each week.
words.es: Propongo que alternemos quién toma el descanso primero cada semana.

words.en: One at a time, please; both of you will be heard.
words.es: Una a la vez, por favor; las dos serán escuchadas.

words.en: Does it seem fair if each one covers the other?
words.es: ¿Les parece justo si cada una cubre a la otra?

lessons.speaking: You are the RN colleague, and the AI is a nurse in a break-room dispute: hear her version, report what each nurse said (dijo que…, decía que…), and propose a fair break rotation.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (dijo que estaba cubriendo, ella decía que no había nadie)

examples.es: Ella decía que no había tiempo para avisarme.
examples.en: She was saying there wasn't time to let me know.

examples.es: Él dijo que ya había tomado su descanso.
examples.en: He said he had already taken his break.

lessons.title: Keep the Team Going on a Short-Staffed Night
lessons.objective: Encourage tired colleagues and make clear commitments about what you will take on tonight.

words.en: I will take care of tonight's admissions.
words.es: Yo me encargaré de los ingresos de esta noche.

words.en: I will ask the shift supervisor for backup.
words.es: Pediré refuerzo a la supervisora de turno.

words.en: You are doing very well, truly.
words.es: Ustedes lo están haciendo muy bien, de verdad.

words.en: Tonight we'll work in pairs and support each other.
words.es: Hoy trabajaremos en parejas y nos apoyaremos mutuamente.

words.en: I'll cover your patients while you take your break.
words.es: Yo cubriré tus pacientes mientras tomas tu pausa.

words.en: I'll call the supervisor and let you know what she says.
words.es: Llamaré a la supervisora y les avisaré qué me dice.

words.en: If anyone feels overwhelmed, tell me and we'll sort it out.
words.es: Si alguien se siente abrumado, díganmelo y lo resolveremos.

words.en: Thank you for your effort; we'll get through this together.
words.es: Gracias por su esfuerzo; saldremos adelante juntos.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead RN, and the AI is a tired colleague on a short-staffed night: divide the tasks, promise what you will take on using the future (me encargaré de…), and encourage them.

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (yo me encargaré de..., ustedes lo están haciendo muy bien)

examples.es: Mañana hablaré con la supervisora sobre más refuerzo.
examples.en: Tomorrow I will talk to the supervisor about more backup.

examples.es: Ustedes están trabajando increíble esta noche.
examples.en: You are working incredibly well tonight.

lessons.title: Same Delay, Four Voices: Patient, Daughter, Doctor, Manager
lessons.objective: Explain one delayed test to four listeners, changing between usted and tú and softening requests.

words.en: I would like to explain why your test was delayed, sir.
words.es: Quisiera explicarle por qué su estudio se atrasó, señor.

words.en: Would you mind waiting a little longer in your room?
words.es: ¿Le importaría esperar un poco más en su cuarto?

words.en: Your dad is fine; the test was delayed three hours.
words.es: Tu papá está bien; el estudio se atrasó tres horas.

words.en: Could you stay with him while we wait?
Doctor, according to radiology, the CT scan was delayed three hours.
words.es: Doctor, según radiología, la tomografía se atrasó tres horas.

words.en: Could radiology give us an estimated time, please?
words.es: ¿Podría radiología darnos una hora estimada, por favor?

words.en: I inform you that the patient's test was rescheduled.
words.es: Le informo que el estudio del paciente se reprogramó.

words.en: I would like to ask you for help coordinating with the radiology technician.
words.es: Quisiera pedirle apoyo para coordinar con el técnico de radiología.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN, and the AI is, in turn, an older patient, his daughter, a physician and the unit manager: explain the delayed scan to each, switching usted/tú and softening requests with quisiera and ¿podrías…?

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera, ¿le importaría...?, ¿podrías...?)

examples.es: Quisiera pedirle un favor, doctor.
examples.en: I would like to ask you a favor, doctor.

examples.es: ¿Podrías ayudarme con tu papá un momento?
examples.en: Could you help me with your dad for a moment?

lessons.title: Needlestick Injury: Tell Employee Health What Happened
lessons.objective: Tell a supervisor, in order and with time markers, how a needlestick happened and what you did next.

words.en: At 2 I pricked my finger with a used needle.
words.es: A las 2 me pinché el dedo con una aguja usada.

words.en: While I was disposing of the needle, I felt the prick.
words.es: Mientras desechaba la aguja, sentí el piquete.
words.note: "Piquete" is common Mexican Spanish for a prick or sting.

words.en: Right after, I took off the glove and washed with soap.
words.es: Justo después, me quité el guante y me lavé con jabón.

words.en: I told my supervisor right away and came to employee health.
words.es: Enseguida le avisé a mi supervisora y vine a salud ocupacional.

words.en: According to the hospital protocol, they will draw my blood tests today.
words.es: Según el protocolo del hospital, me harán análisis de sangre hoy.

words.en: After washing, I filled out the exposure form.
words.es: Después de lavarme, llené el formulario de exposición.

words.en: When will I know if I need post-exposure prophylaxis?
words.es: ¿Cuándo sabré si necesito la profilaxis posexposición?
words.note: Formal; the decision belongs to the provider.

words.en: Thank you for listening; what should I do now, per the protocol?
words.es: Gracias por escucharme; ¿qué debo hacer ahora, según el protocolo?

lessons.speaking: You are the RN who just had a needlestick, and the AI is your supervisor at employee health: report in order what happened and what you did, using past tense with a las 2, mientras, justo después and enseguida.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las dos, justo después, mientras, enseguida)

examples.es: A las 2 me pinché; justo después, me lavé la mano.
examples.en: At 2 I pricked myself; right after, I washed my hand.

examples.es: Mientras tiraba la tapa, sentí un piquete.
examples.en: While I was throwing away the cap, I felt a prick.

lessons.title: Almost the Wrong Vial: A Near-Miss Talk Without Blame
lessons.objective: Talk through a near miss with a colleague, describe what almost happened, and agree on a safer habit.

words.note: Often used with the present tense: por poco le damos...

words.en: We almost gave the patient the wrong vial.
words.es: Por poco le damos el vial equivocado al paciente.

words.en: I almost took it from the shelf without reading the label.
words.es: Casi lo tomé del estante sin leer la etiqueta.

words.en: If I had read more slowly, I would have seen the difference.
words.es: Si hubiera leído más despacio, habría visto la diferencia.

words.en: It could have been a serious error.
words.es: Podría haber sido un error grave.

words.en: If we had fewer interruptions, we would read each label better.
words.es: Si tuviéramos menos interrupciones, leeríamos mejor cada etiqueta.

words.en: Thanks to the scanner, the error did not reach the patient.
words.es: Gracias al escáner, el error no llegó al paciente.

words.en: It's nobody's fault; let's see how to make it safer.
words.es: No es culpa de nadie; veamos cómo hacerlo más seguro.

words.en: Do you agree we read the label aloud before scanning?
words.es: ¿Te parece bien leer la etiqueta en voz alta antes de escanear?

lessons.speaking: You are the RN whose scan caught a look-alike vial, and the AI is a fellow nurse: talk through what almost happened without blame and agree on one safer habit, using por poco, casi, podría haber and si hubiera...

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (por poco le damos..., si hubiera leído más despacio...)

examples.es: Por poco le damos el vial equivocado.
examples.en: We almost gave the wrong vial.

examples.es: Si hubiera leído más despacio, lo habría notado.
examples.en: If I had read more slowly, I would have noticed it.

lessons.title: Fire Alarm While Patients Are on Oxygen: Short Commands
lessons.objective: Give short, clear spoken commands to colleagues and patients during a fire alarm on the unit.

words.note: Common hospital term for a fire; follow your facility's code.

words.en: This is the nurse on floor 4; the fire alarm is sounding.
words.es: Habla la enfermera del piso 4; suena la alarma de incendio.
words.note: Said on the phone to the operator.

words.en: Close the patient room doors, please.
words.es: Cierren las puertas de los cuartos, por favor.

words.en: Don't use the elevator; move to the safe zone.
words.es: No usen el elevador; muévanse a la zona segura.

words.en: If the plan says so, close the oxygen valve.
words.es: Si el plan lo indica, cierren la válvula de oxígeno.

words.en: If the alarm sounds, we will move to the safe zone.
words.es: Si suena la alarma, nos moveremos a la zona segura.

words.en: Stay here, sir; if we must move you, we will help you.
words.es: Quédese aquí, señor; si hay que moverlo, lo ayudaremos.

words.en: If there is smoke, I will tell the operator and let you know what to do.
words.es: Si hay humo, avisaré a la operadora y les diré qué hacer.

words.en: Count your patients and tell me if anyone is missing.
words.es: Cuenten a sus pacientes y avisen si falta alguien.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN on a unit where patients are on oxygen, and the AI is the hospital operator, colleagues and patients: phone in the alarm, give short commands like cierren la puerta, and explain next steps with si + future.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short radio or phone commands (si suena la alarma, nos moveremos; cierren la puerta)

examples.es: Si suena la alarma, cerraremos las puertas.
examples.en: If the alarm sounds, we will close the doors.

examples.es: Cierren la puerta y no usen el elevador.
examples.en: Close the door and don't use the elevator.

lessons.title: Walking the Surveyor Through Patient Identification
lessons.objective: Explain formally to an outside surveyor how patients are identified and how a medication is verified.

words.en: Good morning; I'm happy to explain how we identify patients.
words.es: Buenos días; con gusto le explico cómo identificamos a los pacientes.

words.en: The wristband is checked against the name and date of birth.
words.es: Se verifica la pulsera con el nombre y la fecha de nacimiento.

words.en: The patient is asked for their name and date of birth.
words.es: Se le pide al paciente su nombre y fecha de nacimiento.

words.en: Then the medication code and the wristband code are scanned.
words.es: Después se escanea el código del medicamento y el de la pulsera.

words.en: The identification policy is on the hospital intranet.
words.es: La política de identificación está en la intranet del hospital.
words.note: Formal; refers the surveyor to the written policy.

words.en: If the data don't match, the medication is not given.
words.es: Si no coinciden los datos, no se administra el medicamento.

words.en: I'm glad to show you where it is written in the policy manual.
words.es: Con gusto le muestro dónde está escrito en el manual de políticas.

words.en: Would you like to see how the administration is documented?
words.es: ¿Le gustaría ver cómo se documenta la administración?

lessons.speaking: You are the RN on a medication pass, and the AI is an outside surveyor: explain formally, with usted and passive se (se verifica la pulsera, se escanea el código), how patients are identified, and point to where the policy is written.

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (se verifica la pulsera, se escanea el código)

examples.es: Se escanea el código antes de dar el medicamento.
examples.en: The code is scanned before the medication is given.

examples.es: Se confirman dos datos del paciente, no solo el nombre.
examples.en: Two pieces of patient data are confirmed, not just the name.

lessons.title: Chart a Refusal: A Patient Declines a Treatment
lessons.objective: Write a clear, factual note about a patient's refusal, what was explained, and who was told.

words.en: The patient refused the treatment; therefore, I notified the physician.
words.es: El paciente rechazó el tratamiento; por lo tanto, avisé al médico.

words.en: The consequences were explained to him; in addition, alternatives were offered.
words.es: Se le explicaron las consecuencias; además, se le ofrecieron alternativas.

words.en: However, the patient said: "I don't want the treatment."
words.es: Sin embargo, el paciente dijo: «No quiero el tratamiento».
words.note: Write the patient's exact words in quotation marks.

words.en: Next, the time the physician was notified is recorded.
words.es: A continuación, se anota la hora en que se notificó al médico.

words.en: Per policy, the refusal is documented in the patient's own words.
words.es: Según la política, se documenta la negativa con palabras del paciente.

words.en: The patient was oriented and understood the explanation.
words.es: El paciente estaba orientado y entendió la explicación.
words.note: Chart only what you observed, not your opinion.

words.en: I wrote what he said, without adding my opinion.
words.es: Escribí lo que dijo, sin agregar mi opinión.

words.en: Would you like me to explain again before you sign the form?
words.es: ¿Quiere que le explique otra vez antes de firmar el formulario?

lessons.speaking: You are the RN writing the refusal note, and the AI is the charge nurse who asks what happened: dictate a neutral note using por lo tanto, además, sin embargo and a continuación, with the patient's exact words.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (por lo tanto, además, sin embargo, a continuación)

examples.es: El paciente declinó la cirugía; por lo tanto, se notificó al médico.
examples.en: The patient declined the surgery; therefore, the physician was notified.

examples.es: Se le explicó el procedimiento; además, se le entregó información escrita.
examples.en: The procedure was explained to him; in addition, written information was given.

lessons.title: Follow-Up Call After Discharge, Then a Reminder Text
lessons.objective: Phone a discharged patient, verify identity before sharing information, and send a polite follow-up text.

words.en: Good afternoon, this is Laura, a nurse from the clinic.
words.es: Buenas tardes, le habla Laura, enfermera de la clínica.

words.en: Am I speaking with Mr. Ramírez?
Could you confirm your date of birth for me, please?
words.es: ¿Podría confirmarme su fecha de nacimiento, por favor?
words.note: Formal; always verify identity before sharing information.

words.en: I would appreciate it if you confirmed your address before we continue.
words.es: Le agradecería que me confirmara su dirección antes de continuar.

words.en: For your privacy, I can't give information without confirming who you are.
words.es: Por su privacidad, no puedo dar información sin confirmar quién es.

words.en: How have you felt since you left the hospital?
words.es: ¿Cómo se ha sentido desde que salió del hospital?

words.en: Could you tell me if you've had a fever or new pain?
words.es: ¿Podría decirme si ha tenido fiebre o dolor nuevo?

words.en: Reminder: your appointment is Thursday at 10:00 a.m.
words.es: Recordatorio: su cita es el jueves a las 10:00 a. m.

lessons.speaking: You are the RN phoning a patient two days after discharge, and the AI is the patient: confirm identity first with ¿podría confirmarme…?, ask about symptoms, then say the text you will send using le agradecería que….

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (¿podría confirmarme su fecha de nacimiento?, le agradecería que...)

examples.es: ¿Podría repetirme su número de teléfono, por favor?
examples.en: Could you repeat your phone number for me, please?

examples.es: Le agradecería que me devolviera la llamada.
examples.en: I would appreciate it if you returned my call.

lessons.title: Home Safety Walkthrough Before a Patient Goes Home
lessons.objective: Walk a patient and daughter through the home plan and say when they should call for help.

words.en: You could call the clinic if the swelling increases.
words.es: Podría llamar a la clínica si la hinchazón aumenta.

words.en: As long as you follow the plan, you'll be safer at home.
words.es: Con tal de que siga el plan, estará más seguro en casa.

words.en: As long as you get up slowly, you'll avoid dizziness.
words.es: Siempre que se levante despacio, evitará los mareos.

words.en: Call the clinic if you have a fever or pain that gets worse.
words.es: Llame a la clínica si tiene fiebre o dolor que empeora.

words.en: Call 911 if there is chest pain or sudden confusion.
words.es: Llamen al 911 si hay dolor de pecho o confusión repentina.
words.note: Plural command to patient and daughter.

words.en: Per the doctor's order, the schedule is on this sheet.
words.es: Según la orden del médico, el horario está en esta hoja.

words.en: It would be good to remove the rugs before he arrives.
words.es: Sería bueno quitar los tapetes antes de que él llegue.

words.en: Could you put a night light near the bathroom?
words.es: ¿Podría poner una luz de noche cerca del baño?

lessons.speaking: You are the RN on discharge day, and the AI is the patient's daughter: review the written plan and tell her when to call the clinic, using podría llamar si…, siempre que and con tal de que.

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (siempre que, podría llamar si..., con tal de que)

examples.es: Podría llamar a la clínica si el dolor empeora.
examples.en: You could call the clinic if the pain gets worse.

examples.es: Siempre que alguien lo acompañe, puede usar la regadera.
examples.en: As long as someone accompanies him, he can use the shower.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Night Shift Where Nothing Goes to Plan
lessons.objective: Lead a full hard night shift in Spanish, from teaching to a crisis to a safe handoff and a written note.

words.en: First I'll show you the crash cart; then we'll check the unit together.
words.es: Primero te muestro el carro de paro; después revisamos juntas la unidad.

words.en: I found an allergy that wasn't in the chart; I notified the doctor.
words.es: Encontré una alergia que no estaba en el expediente; avisé al doctor.

words.en: Doctor, I'm reading back the phone order word for word; is that correct?
words.es: Doctor, repito la orden telefónica palabra por palabra; ¿es correcto?

words.en: I understand your intention, but don't give him anything without the doctor's permission.
words.es: Entiendo su intención, pero no le dé nada sin permiso del médico.

words.en: I want us to reach an agreement that works for both of you.
words.es: Quiero que lleguemos a un acuerdo que funcione para las dos.

words.en: The alarm was silenced and the occlusion was corrected.
words.es: Se silenció la alarma y se corrigió la oclusión.
words.note: Formal passive se, used in written reports.

words.en: The physician was notified and the exact time was recorded.
words.es: Se avisó al médico y se anotó la hora exacta.

words.en: I'm handing off to you; the night was hard, but everyone is stable.
words.es: Les entrego el relevo; la noche fue difícil, pero todos están estables.

lessons.speaking: You are the night RN leading a full shift, and the AI plays your coworkers, the doctor, a visitor and the morning nurse in turn: orient, handle each situation, and finish with a handoff, using sequence words, commands, se passives and past tenses.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar (sequence, commands, preterite/imperfect, subjunctive, register, formal passive se)

examples.es: Primero llamé al doctor; después anoté la orden.
examples.en: First I called the doctor; then I wrote down the order.

examples.es: Se avisó al médico en cuanto se encontró la alergia.
examples.en: The doctor was notified as soon as the allergy was found.
